question: Which Linux companion app architecture should OpenClaw sponsor as the canonical in-repo path, and should this issue remain the umbrella until that path lands?
rationale: Current main solves much of the Windows side, but Linux remains a broad, security-sensitive product surface with multiple active implementation candidates and no merged owner-approved architecture.

options.title: Keep umbrella and choose Linux track
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the active Linux PRs side by side and choose one security-reviewed architecture to land or narrow.

options.title: Split remaining Linux work
options.body: Close or narrow this umbrella only after creating a canonical Linux companion app issue that preserves the open PR context and parity gaps.

options.title: Route Linux companion outside core
options.body: Declare native Linux companion apps external for now, close the in-repo request, and direct contributors to maintain a plugin or external app instead.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella and choose Linux track
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the active Linux PRs side by side and choose one security-reviewed architecture to land or narrow.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete opened the tracker, set early GTK-native direction in the discussion, and has recent platform/app status history in the repository.
